description: An event published when an instance is created or destroyed
title: io.synadia.ntf.event.v1.instance_action

id.description: Unique id of this event, a nuid

timestamp.description: The publisher's clock when the event was made, in RFC 3339 with nanoseconds

instance_id.description: The instance the event is about

source.description: The component that published the event

source_seq.description: Counts the source's events for the instance from 1 with no gaps

kind.description: The instance's kind, such as server, cluster or super-cluster, set on created

backend.description: The name of the backend running the instance's servers, set on created

reason.description: The request that destroyed the instance, set on destroyed
